odc_type: Logic error in handling duplicate keys
observation_summary: The application throws an IndexOutOfBoundsException when attempting to add a duplicate X value to an XYSeries that allows duplicates.
reasoning_summary: The code in XYSeries.addOrUpdate fails to account for the 'allowDuplicateXValues' flag when determining whether to update an existing item or insert a new one. When duplicates are allowed, the method should append or insert the new item rather than overwriting the existing one. The current implementation incorrectly assumes that finding an existing index via binary search always necessitates an update, leading to an IndexOutOfBoundsException or incorrect data overwriting when the logic attempts to manipulate the list based on the search result.
